# Carlos Rendón

> AI proposes, the human decides. Carlos Rendón builds Salesforce systems for the health and public sectors, and AI tools where a person makes the final call. Based in Brisbane, Australia; remote or hybrid. Also a writer of transmedia fiction and an AI-assisted music producer. English and Spanish. Available for contracts now.

Contact: carlos.rendon.duque@gmail.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/carlosrendonduque/ · https://github.com/carlosrendonduque

- [Work](https://carlosrendon.co/en/work/): Salesforce and OmniStudio for health, public sector and insurance; 8 Salesforce certifications.
- [Consulting](https://carlosrendon.co/en/consulting/): free scoping chat with an AI assistant (the chat on every page); readiness review (AUD 2,500, two weeks); build and integrate.
- [Lab](https://carlosrendon.co/en/lab/): Conserje (lead-qualifying chat routed through n8n; the chat on this site), WorkBrain (MCP memory server), Bayzara (agents that ask before they act), Conato (editor where the model only proposes), calamus, tonotopia.
- [Art](https://carlosrendon.co/en/art/): Toma 1024 (Master's thesis, in development), Nullheim, Fragmentado, Parallax Story, and music (Koombia Mate).
